lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Kitten ( ΦωΦ )

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Are you busy right now?
No, I'm good.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: That's good to hear.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: It's not a big deal,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: but there's something we wanted to ask you.
Sure, what's up?

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: You know how it's been just Prika and me lately,

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: without Anis?

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: It's not because of any conflict, contract issues, or anything like that.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Things just kind of naturally went from the three of us to the two of us.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: So I thought maybe we could do something for her.
Do something for her?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: I know it sounds kinda over the top,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: but we're thinking of doing a farewell event for her.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: I just want to throw her a small party

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: to show her how much we appreciate

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: all the hard work she's put in!
That's actually a pretty good idea.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Right? You think Anis would like it too?
For sure.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: We'll take care of the party prep,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: so could you bring Anis and the rest of the Counters over?
You sure you don't need my help?

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: We've worked with Anis for years, after all.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: We know exactly what she likes,

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: so we'll have everything ready in no time.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: I've already prepared two cases of soda.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: We'll stack them into a tower first,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: then put a star-shaped cake on top.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Then, we'll play the songs we used to sing together in the background,

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: and scatter old practice photos all over the floor.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: The second she walks in, we'll fire off the party poppers.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: If you're standing there waiting for her, it'll be perfect.
You want me to stand in the middle?
I dunno, that's a lot of pressure.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Even if it is, there's nothing we can do about it.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: You're the greatest gift of all, Kitten.
I am??

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Anis is gonna love it.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Trust us!
Okay...

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: I'll let you know once everything's ready!
Even though they don't work together anymore, they're still close.
I'm glad Anis has friends like that.
